verdict.rationale: The Gemini API documents implicit caching, on by default for Gemini 2.5 and newer models, with cost savings passed on automatically when a request hits the cache. The pricing page lists context caching access as a paid-tier feature, but the evidence shows no cached-token rates or storage pricing. Missing for 10: specific cached-token and storage pricing, documented latency benefits, details of explicit context-cache configuration (TTL, minimum tokens), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can cut cost and latency on repeated context with documented prompt/prefix caching and its pricing

citations.quote: Implicit caching is enabled by default for all Gemini 2.5 and newer models. ... We automatically pass on cost savings if your request hits caches.
